name: cargo-chef skeleton needs non-manifest build.rs inputs
description: cargo-chef cook in .fabro/Dockerfile.toolchain (fabro-c643): the chef skeleton reconstructs manifests+dummy sources only, so build.rs inputs outside manifests must be staged beside the skeleton — fabro-api's build.rs reads docs/public/api-reference/fabro-api.yaml relative to the workspace root and panics without it. scripts/run-images.nu stages the git-tracked cook context into .fabro/cook/ (ignored), the Dockerfile planner stage reduces it to recipe.json, and the cooker COPYs the spec alongside. Warm layers land in /opt/target with CARGO_TARGET_DIR baked; clippy legs stay cold (clippy-driver fingerprints).
